descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**🔥 NEW IN 1.5: INFINITE MODE**

Race the clock against ever-angrier waves. Kill fast to survive and climb a new leaderboard. Plus a redesigned ship and refreshed visuals.

- "A fun and challenging throwback to the arcade shooters of old." - UploadVR
- "Reinvents the classic shoot 'em up for virtual reality." - NGP Noticias
- "A fast and competitive arcade action experience." - OneDigital

[media]

**Blast, bomb and boost** through a neon warzone in this **twin-stick arcade shmup** built for VR. Destroy infected constructs, defeat colossal bosses and purge the system before total collapse.

[media]
Rogue AI Typhon is corrupting the Core. As **Interceptor C11-28**, you're humanity's last defence.

[media]

# FIVE DISTRICTS. FIVE BOSSES.
Fight through five districts, each ending in a multi-stage boss battle, building to the final showdown with Typhon.

# FEATURES

- 360° VR arcade combat
- **NEW:** Infinite Mode
- Upgrade weapons, boosts and abilities
- Arcade Mode and Stage Select
- Global leaderboards
- Seated twin-stick controls

[media]
# GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS
Climb the global rankings across every mode and district. Perfect for fans of shmups, bullet hell and high-score chasing.

Perfect for fans of **arcade shooters**, **bullet hell**, **shmups**, **twin-stick shooters**, **space shooters**, **boss battles** and high-score chasing.
[media] 
A portion of Rhino Rock Studios' profits funds conservation worldwide, so every run helps real-world change.
